record.paper_title: Some Open Problems on Multiple Ergodic Averages
record.original_question: Let a(n) be one of the sequences of prime numbers p_n, the Hardy-type sequence [n^c] with c > 0, or the exponential sequence 2^n. For every ergodic system (X, X, μ, T) and bounded measurable f0, ..., fℓ, does the multiple correlation sequence ∫ f0 · T^{a(n)}f1 · ... · T^{ℓ a(n)}fℓ dμ always admit a decomposition ψ(a(n)) + e(n), where ψ is an ℓ-step nilsequence and the Cesàro mean of |e(n)| tends to 0?

evidence.quote: Problem 13. Let (a(n)) be the sequence of integers (pn), where pn is the n-th prime, or ([n^c]), where c > 0, or (2^n). Is it true that for every ergodic system (X, X , µ, T) and all functions f0, . . . , f` ∈ L∞(µ), one has a decomposition ∫ f0 · T^a(n)f1 · . . . · T^`a(n)f` dµ = ψ(a(n)) + e(n), where (ψ(n)) is an (`-step) nilsequence and limN→∞ (1/N) ΣN n=1 |e(n)| = 0?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\ell\ge 1$ be an integer and let $(a(n))_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$ denote one of the following integer sequences:
(i) $a(n)=p_n$, the $n$-th prime number;
(ii) $a(n)=\lfloor n^c\rfloor$ for a fixed real number $c>0$;
(iii) $a(n)=2^n$.

Recall that an $\ell$-step nilsequence is a sequence of the form $(F(g^n\cdot x))_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$, where $G/\Gamma$ is an $\ell$-step nilmanifold ($G$ a connected, simply connected nilpotent Lie group of step $\ell$ and $\Gamma$ a cocompact discrete subgroup), $g\in G$, $x\in G/\Gamma$, and $F:G/\Gamma\to\mathbb{C}$ is continuous; more generally, an $\ell$-step nilsequence is a uniform limit of such sequences.

Let $(X,\mathcal{X},\mu,T)$ be an invertible ergodic measure-preserving system on a standard probability space, and let $f_0,f_1,\dots,f_\ell\in L^\infty(\mu)$. Define the multiple correlation sequence
$$A(n)=\int_X f_0\cdot (T^{a(n)}f_1)\cdot (T^{2a(n)}f_2)\cdots (T^{\ell\, a(n)}f_\ell)\,d\mu.$$

Decide whether, for every such system and choice of functions, there exists a decomposition
$$A(n)=\psi(a(n))+e(n),\quad n\in\mathbb{N},$$
where $(\psi(n))_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$ is an $\ell$-step nilsequence and the error sequence $(e(n))$ satisfies
$$\lim_{N\to\infty}\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}|e(n)|=0.$$
artifact.status_search_result: For the prime case, partial results are known: a decomposition of multicorrelation sequences along primes has been established (in a commuting-transformations setting), but only in the weaker form where for every ε>0 one obtains a nilsequence plus an error term with small Cesàro and uniform averages depending on ε, rather than the single error term with vanishing Cesàro mean of |e(n)| as posed. Subsequent work on nilsequences and multiple correlations along subsequences has refined these results, but the full problem as stated for p_n, ⌊n^c⌋, and 2^n does not appear to be completely resolved.

status_evidence.title: A decomposition of multicorrelation sequences for commuting transformations along primes
status_evidence.snippet: Any multicorrelation sequence for commuting transformations can be decomposed, for every ε>0, as the sum of a nilsequence φ(n) and a sequence ω(n) with small averages along the integers and along the primes.
status_evidence.claim: Provides a partial (ε-dependent) decomposition along primes, addressing Frantzikinakis's problem in a weaker form.

status_evidence.title: Nilsequences and multiple correlations along subsequences
status_evidence.snippet: Studies decomposition of multiple correlation sequences along subsequences such as primes and Hardy-type sequences.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent partial progress on the subsequence version of the problem.

status_evidence.title: Structured extensions and multi-correlation sequences
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work continuing to study decomposition results for multi-correlation sequences.
status_evidence.claim: Indicates the problem remains an active topic, suggesting it is not fully resolved in the form stated.
